cohort: Eight pregnant and postpartum women with COVID-19 ARDS requiring ECMO support
finding: ECMO support for pregnant and postpartum women with severe COVID-19 ARDS resulted in 100% maternal and neonatal survival rates, suggesting ECMO is a safe and life-saving therapy for this patient population.
mod_finding: The study found that ECMO support for pregnant and postpartum patients with COVID-19-related ARDS resulted in a 100% neonatal and maternal survival rate, suggesting that ECMO is safe and life-saving in this population.
